verdictEs: Mobalytics para editorial accesible y web; Nightreign Calculator para data datamined raw y modo offline.
verdictEn: Mobalytics for accessible editorial and web; Nightreign Calculator for raw datamined data and offline mode.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics tiene tier lists, recommended builds, build orders. Calculator es lookup raw sin opinion.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics has tier lists, recommended builds, build orders. Calculator is raw lookup with no opinion.

useCases.labelEs: Drop rates exactos de relics raros
useCases.labelEn: Exact drop rates of rare relics
useCases.reasonEs: Calculator extrae data del game files con drop conditions exactos. Mobalytics filtra editorial.
useCases.reasonEn: Calculator extracts game-file data with exact drop conditions. Mobalytics filters editorial.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics es web + mobile apps; Calculator es Windows desktop only.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics is web + mobile apps; Calculator is Windows desktop only.

useCases.reasonEs: Calculator funciona sin internet después de install. Mobalytics requiere conexión.
useCases.reasonEn: Calculator works without internet after install. Mobalytics requires connection.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics updatea editorial dentro de 1-2 semanas. Calculator depende de re-extracción de game files que tarda más.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics updates editorial within 1-2 weeks. Calculator depends on game-file re-extraction which takes longer.
